Soft pieces

Green salmon with rice

Zöld lazac rizzsel

8 months+ Sound idea 30 min 3 portions

Serve soft and warm after a final bone check. Refrigerate rice and eat it within a day.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 100 g boneless salmon fillet (bones checked)
  • 60 g spinach (washed)
  • 80 g broccoli (small florets)
  • 60 g rice (dry weight, rinsed)
  • 1 tsp olive oil (stirred in at the end)
  • as needed water (for boiling the rice and vegetables)

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Boil the rice in plenty of unsalted water until soft, then drain it and spread it to cool quickly.
  2. Simmer the broccoli until it mashes, and wilt the spinach in the same pan.
  3. Poach the salmon until it flakes, then check the flakes and remove any bone.
  4. Stir the rice, vegetables, and salmon together and break up any firm piece.
  5. Stir in the olive oil.

Sound idea

This plate is already suitable at 8 months when the salmon is boneless and the rice and vegetables are soft. A missed bone, or rice left sitting warm, is the hazard to manage.

No reformulation is needed. Check the salmon for bones, stir in a teaspoon of olive oil at the end, and cool the rice quickly.
